_help: Monitors are Boolean queries. Syntax: "phrase", word, comput*, case:AI, context:nus, @alias, AND OR NOT (capitals), ( ). Test changes in the dashboard's Query tester before committing.

aliases.soc: "NUS Computing" OR "NUS School of Computing" OR "NUS SoC" OR "School of Computing, NUS" OR "School of Computing at NUS"
aliases.socLoose: @soc OR ((NUS OR context:nus) AND ("School of Computing" OR SoC OR "computer science" OR computing OR case:CS*))
aliases.programmes: "computer science" OR "business analytics" OR "business AI systems" OR "information security" OR "computer engineering" OR infosec OR "info sec" OR "artificial intelligence" OR case:CS* OR case:DISA OR case:BAIS OR case:BZA

monitors.name: SoC mentions
monitors.query: @soc OR (context:nus AND ("School of Computing" OR SoC))

monitors.name: Programmes
monitors.description: SoC programmes and student discussion of them
monitors.query: (@soc OR NUS OR context:nus) AND (@programmes) NOT "counter strike"

monitors.name: Potential issues
monitors.description: Reputational risk: misconduct, security incidents, fraud
monitors.query: @socLoose AND (controversy OR misconduct OR investigat* OR leak* OR hacked OR breach OR discriminat* OR harass* OR plagiaris* OR scam OR fraud OR outage OR cheat*)

monitors.name: Teaching and learning
monitors.description: Professors, lectures, modules, grades (split out of Potential issues)
monitors.query: @socLoose AND (professor OR prof OR lecturer* OR lecture* OR teaching OR tutor* OR module* OR class OR classes OR case:GPA OR case:CAP)

monitors.name: Student experience
monitors.description: Workload, stress, internships, admissions (sentiment comes from the classifier)
monitors.query: (@soc OR "NUS Computer Science" OR "NUS CS" OR "NUS Information Security" OR "NUS InfoSec" OR "NUS DISA" OR "NUS BZA" OR "NUS BAIS" OR (context:nus AND (SoC OR computing OR "computer science" OR case:CS* OR case:BZA OR case:DISA OR case:BAIS))) AND (workload OR stress* OR difficult OR hard OR competitive OR challenging OR internship* OR reject* OR admission* OR curriculum OR module* OR professor OR lecturer*)
